notes: Independent manual full-file review covered all 17 production JS/TS source files, package.json, and openclaw.plugin.json. The complete filesystem enumeration includes the CLAUDE.md instruction alias; 19 reviewed and 22 excluded records partition all 41 files.

All local imports and reexports resolve within extensions/lmstudio. api.ts and runtime-api.ts reexport plugin-owned implementations and local types, not unchanged SDK exports. setup-prompts.ts is production code imported by setup.ts. No shared shipped source leaves the plugin root and no production file imports a test file.

Public SDK module names and original exported names were checked against root package.json exports and their src/plugin-sdk facades. The plugin production source and consulted facades match the pinned commit; the separately authorized scoped AGENTS edits were treated only as instructions.

Only index.ts register(api: OpenClawPluginApi) proves an API handle: registerEmbeddingProvider and registerProvider are direct calls. Provider catalog/auth/setup/stream contexts, model config objects, returned loggers, embedding provider objects, and the adapter runtime descriptor are not OpenClawPluginApi or PluginRuntime handles. There are no runtime-member or named-hook findings.

buildProviderToolCompatFamilyHooks returns provider callback properties, not api.on/registerHook registrations. Known SDK helper internals, including returned stream wrappers, remote embedding providers, async locks, logger methods and lazy setup loaders, were not expanded into additional SDK/API/runtime consumption.

stream.ts underlying is the unchanged fallback alias ctx.streamFn ?? streamSimple; its direct invocations preserve streamSimple call provenance. Bare fallback selection adds no member-access, and calls through SDK-created wrappers add no transitive call to streamSimple.

Runtime resolveApiKeyForProvider has an ordinary import and direct invocation plus explicit typeof in ReturnType at runtime.ts:227; its export classification is mixed, while provider-auth-runtime module dependency sites remain runtime.

Explicit inline type imports retain type-import. All imported SDK types used in annotations/indexed access carry type-reference; indexed config/provider/embedding types are not API/runtime public member handles. The local barrels do not reexport their inferred SDK constituent types.

Only top-level providers and contracts.embeddingProviders establish agreed manifest-contract identities. Categories, providerCatalogEntry, modelCatalog, providerRequest, modelPricing, auth markers, setup/providerAuthChoices and configSchema metadata do not add contracts under the frozen schema.

Original-owner source reconciliation: models.ts selects base.cost (line 512) and base.contextWindow (line 518) from the plugin-owned mapLmstudioWireEntry result. Those properties retain SELF_HOSTED_DEFAULT_COST unchanged and SELF_HOSTED_DEFAULT_CONTEXT_WINDOW unchanged on its fallback branch, respectively. Both SDK exports therefore include member-access alongside import; classifications and finding counts remain unchanged. The fresh enclosing object does not acquire an API/runtime identity.
